scope: Research-only simulation. Original user departure and preference constraints are preserved. Tail uses a concrete stop/new time and remaining transfer budget. Whole-route line exclusion is a separate sensitivity experiment, not the same correction model. Delay is synthetic, not a traffic measurement.

transfer_scenario.prefix_boundary: At the second boarding stop after any original transfer walk, before boarding the second transit leg. Prefix pedestrian/ride durations unchanged except +480 s on first surface leg; all later prefix timestamps shift accordingly.
transfer_scenario.remaining_budget_reason: First prefix boarding plus tail first boarding consumes one transfer; whole-trip maximum is two.

exclusion_warning: Excluding the entire first line is a conservative sensitivity experiment, not equivalent to injecting an eight-minute delay on one specific road section; it can remove useful unaffected rides and is not an approved product policy.
frequency_warning: Surface GTFS frequencies records have exact_times=0. Modelled departure instants are not evidence of exact physical bus departures; the repeated trip_id may identify a frequency template.
